notes: The list is essentially complete. Massenet wrote almost no original violin music beyond the Thaïs Méditation, and the Élégie is the same melody as the Invocation/Mélodie from Les Érinnyes already listed. Other violin versions (Le dernier sommeil de la Vierge, Aragonaise from Le Cid) are publisher or amateur arrangements rather than established violinist transcriptions, so I left them out.
